Our Services What Day2 offers Furniture Consultancy Our team is dedicated to helping you create a commercial furniture specification that meets your individual requirements. With access to over 500 high-quality furniture brands, we provide a vast selection of options to help bring your vision to reality. From contemporary and bold, to classic and refined, we create workspaces that accurately reflect your unique style. Furniture Procurement We use our extensive supplier base to negotiate the best deals for you. Our commitment to quality means that you will always receive the utmost value for your investment, and we take pride in sourcing furniture that exceeds your expectations. Furniture Circularity Through our Day2 Renew program, we offer our clients a fresh and innovative approach towards managing their furniture assets. We work closely with our clients to conduct thorough real estate audits, in order to identify opportunities for repurposing, refurbishing, and reimaging existing furniture assets, thereby avoiding any unnecessary landfill waste. Our close partnerships with both manufacturing and charitable organisations help us maintain a circular economy. Project Management & Installation Our experienced project managers are here to handle your projects with care and precision. Whether it's buildings in London or across the UK and Europe, we ensure every detail is taken care of from conception to completion, providing you with a seamless journey and flawless results. Building Long-Term Partnerships Our commitment to you doesn’t end when the project is completed. We strive to build long-lasting working partnerships and our exceptional approach to aftercare guarantees we’ll be there to assist and support you whenever you need it. We understand that every client is different, and our expert team is committed to delivering a tailored service that meets those needs. Starting from the briefing phase, through product specification, to furniture installation, we work closely with our clients to ensure that we offer the right products and solutions that fit their needs. 1. Strategy A strategic approach is essential for a successful project. We’ll collaborate with your team to develop a customised plan, including a detailed programme, project milestones, accurate budget, and stakeholder engagement. We curate furniture solutions and prioritise service delivery to ensure that from start to finish, every aspect of the project is delivered smoothly and efficiently. 2. Management Our practised project managers have successfully delivered projects to landmark buildings across London, the UK & Europe, and we have formed a trusted and capable network, with proven expertise in logistics, installation, and relocation services. 3. Specification We’ll take the time to fully understand your brief and build a furniture specification bespoke to your requirements. Our focus is on delivering a curated selection of furniture that reflects your style and enhances your space. We also consider your organisation’s technology and services to ensure seamless furniture integration. 4. SustainaBility We strive for sustainability and empower our clients with reliable data and insights to help them make responsible choices. Our circular solutions, including audits, reuse strategies, remanufacturing, resale, and recycling options, extend the life of existing furniture assets while minimising environmental impact and waste. 5. Procurement Day2 pride ourselves on our meticulous attention to detail in all aspects of service, including procurement. We have extensive experience procuring furniture packages, ranging from the most basic to highly complex, large-scale orders.
